### hd-body-apostrophe
cat <<EOF
I can't do this
EOF
rm -rf /tmp/x
### hd-body-dquote
cat <<EOF
say "hi
EOF
rm -rf /tmp/x
### hd-body-backtick
cat <<EOF
run `foo
EOF
rm -rf /tmp/x
### hd-body-dollar-brace
cat <<EOF
${FMT_BLUE}hello${FMT_RESET}
EOF
rm -rf /tmp/x
### hd-body-apostrophe-quoted-term
cat <<'EOF'
I can't do this
EOF
rm -rf /tmp/x
### hd-body-paren
cat <<EOF
if (x) {
EOF
rm -rf /tmp/x
### hd-fn-body-apostrophe-then-fn
f() {
cat <<EOF
we're here
EOF
apt-get install -y docker
}
f
rm -rf /tmp/x
